title: Printer Buddy 1.2.5: drawers, dev builds and Save config
body: New ☰ drawers: on a printer page for restarts, host power and services; on the home page for restarting Printer Buddy, its services and Updates (moved out of Settings). Hold a part's name in Updates to put just that part on dev/beta builds. Klipper errors and warnings now show on the printer page, a Save config button appears after calibrations, console arrow keys go through history again and Collapse moved to the bottom of the sidebar. New docs site too.

title: Printer Buddy v2.0 is out 🎉
body: New dashboard you can rearrange, 20+ new panels, job queue, config editor and more. Please enjoy!
